principle: Every non-terminal project must have a live next path, bounded wait, accountable owner and governed escalation.
invariants: A human authority gate may be escalated or reassigned within policy but never automatically approved
Every waiting state requires an accountable owner and explicit release condition
Every waiting state has a next-check time and bounded escalation window
Queue aging prevents indefinite starvation of lower-priority work
Provider fallback may only use certified eligible paths and may not create Production authority
Repeated same-state re-entry is treated as a loop rather than progress
No-progress heartbeat triggers recheck or escalation before a project becomes silently stuck
Anti-bottleneck controls must not weaken fraud, compliance, security, commercial or Production gates
